summary: PGIM Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly owned SPV borrower, PGIM Private Credit Fund ABL LLC, entered into Amendment No. 1 to a Loan Financing and Servicing Agreement dated May 5, 2026, with Deutsche Bank AG, New York Branch as facility agent and lender and State Street as collateral agent and custodian. The amendment, dated September 18, 2026, upsized the facility from $100 million to $200 million, repriced the applicable margin, and revised certain concentration and reporting covenants. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; watch portfolio ramp, leverage, and covenant compliance.
